# User Guides

[HPC Tutorials](https://it.tufts.edu/high-performance-computing/hpc-tutorials)

More tutorials:

[HPC New User](https://tufts.app.box.com/v/HPC-New-User)

Note, for cluster questions: `tts-research@tufts.edu`

## General Information

### Storage

Your Home Directory (10GB, fixed) should be: `/cluster/home/your_utln`

You can check your limit with: `quota -s`

Your research project storage (from 50GB and up) path should be
`/cluster/tufts/yourlabname/`, and each member of the lab group has a
dedicated directory `/cluster/tufts/yourlabname/your_utln`

To see your research project storage quota by running the following
command from login node: `showquota`

Note: research storage is shared within a research group.

#### Uploading Data

* Local_Path is the path to your files or directory on your local
computer

* Cluster_Path is the path to your files or directory on the cluster
Home Directory: `/cluster/home/your_utln/your_folder`

Research Project Storage Space Directory: `/cluster/tufts/yourlabname/your_utln/your_folder`

**Examples:**

Download From Cluster:

```
scp your_utln@xfer.cluster.tufts.edu:Cluster_Path Local_Path
```

_For Example (Tutorial Scripts from Cluster)_

```
emoseley@MacBook-Pro-5 ~ % scp -r emosel01@xfer.cluster.tufts.edu:/cluster/tufts/hpc/tools/WorkshopDemo/20210420 /Users/emoseley/Desktop/example_files
```

Upload to Cluster:

```
scp Local_Path your_utln@xfer.cluster.tufts.edu:Cluster_Path
```

_For Example_

```
scp emosel01@xfer.cluster.tufts.edu:/cluster/tufts/cowenlab/emosel01/data
```

## Environment Setup (Conda)

We use `conda` to control our environment, to list the conda modules, we check:

```
module av anaconda
```

We will load a recent version of Anaconda:

```
module load anaconda/2021.05
```

### Configuring Conda

Since you have limited amount of storage in your home directory, we do no suggest you install the packages
there. As you belong to XXXXlab group on the cluster, please use the group research storage for the purpose.

Create two directories in your group research storage space (one for storing the envs, one for storing the `pkgs`,
for example: `condaenv`, `condapkg`)

```
cd /cluster/tufts/cowenlab/$USER
mkdir condaenv
mkdir condapkg
```

If you haven't used conda before on the cluster, create a file named `".condarc"` in your home directory.


```
cd ~
touch .condarc
conda config --append envs_dirs /cluster/tufts/cowenlab/$USER/condaenv/
conda config --append pkgs_dirs /cluster/tufts/cowenlab/$USER/condapkg/
```

_Optional:_ Add channels to your conda config as well (here are only 2, but you can add more you need):

```
conda config --add channels bioconda
conda config --add channels conda-forge
```

Now we check with `cat ~/.condarc`:

```
envs_dirs:
  - /cluster/tufts/cowenlab/emosel01/condaenv/
pkgs_dirs:
  - /cluster/tufts/cowenlab/emosel01/condapkg/
channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
  - defaults
```

### Create Conda Environment

Now we create a custom conda env


```
cd /cluster/tufts/XXXXlab/$USER/condaenv/
conda create -p yourenvname
```

Note: For a specific version of Python (ex. 3.8), we use:

```
conda create -p yourenvname python=3.8
```

**Note:** you will need to have python and pip installed inside the env to pip install packages inside the env.

**Note:** If you are using system installed conda, please **DO NOT** use `conda activate` to activate your environment, use `source activate yourenvname`.













### Batch Job File

```
!#/bin/sh
#SBATCH -J My_Job_Name #job name
#SBATCH !"time=00-00:20:00 #requested time (DD-HH:MM:SS)
#SBATCH -p preempt #running on "preempt" partition/queue
#SBATCH -N 1 #1 nodes
#SBATCH -n 2 #2 tasks total
#SBATCH -c 1 #1 cpu cores per task
#SBATCH !"mem=2g #requesting 2GB of RAM total
#SBATCH !"output=MyJob.%j.%N.out #saving standard output to file,
%j=JOBID, %N=NodeName
#SBATCH !"error=MyJob.%j.%N.err #saving standard error to file,
%j=JOBID, %N=NodeName
#SBATCH !"mail-type=ALL #email optitions
#SBATCH !"mail-user=Your_Tufts_Email@tufts.edu

!$commands_you_would_like_to_exe_on_the_compute_nodes]

# for example, running a python script
# load the module so the correct version python is available to you
module load anaconda/3
# run python script
python myscript.py #make sure myscript.py exists in the current directory
```

### Submit Job

```
$ sbatch myjob.sh
```

## Administrative

## Connecting to Cluster

Connect to Tufts VPN first with Cisco AnyConnect Mobility Client

```
vpn.tufts.edu/duo
```

Note that 2-Factor Authentication is required (pick up the phone).

Next, `ssh` in:

```
ssh emosel01@login.pax.tufts.edu
```

Password is the same throughout.

## Landing

```
$ pwd
/cluster/home/emosel01
cd
/cluster/tufts/cowenlab/emosel01
```
